1. (Currently amended) A vehicle door comprising: a door outer panel defining an exterior surface of the vehicle door; a common door inner panel located inboard of the door outer panel and configured to mount door hardware, the common door inner panel having a periphery; and a panel extension extending around essentially all of the periphery of the common door inner panel, the panel extension being attached to the periphery of the common door inner panel, forming an inner panel-extension joint, and attached to the door outer panel via a hemmed joint, forming an outer panel-extension joint, to secure the common door inner panel to the door outer panel.

2. (Cancelled)

3. (Currently amended) The vehicle door of claim 1 wherein the inner panel-extension joint includes fasteners securing the panel extension to the common door inner panel, wherein the fasteners are selected from the group consisting of rivets, bolts, and screws.

4. (Cancelled)

5. (Currently amended) A vehicle door comprising: a door outer panel defining an exterior surface of the vehicle door; a common door inner panel located inboard of the door outer panel and configured to mount door hardware, the common door inner panel having a periphery; and a first panel extension extending around essentially all of the periphery of the common door inner panel, the first panel extension being attached to the periphery of the common door inner panel and attached to the door outer panel to secure the common door inner panel to the door outer panel, wherein the common door inner panel is configured to be selectively paired with either the first panel extension and a first door outer panel, or a second panel extension and a second door outer panel, wherein the second panel extension is configured differently from the first panel extension to accommodate design differences of the second door outer panel.
